appearance.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or ICO, up to 5 MB. Leave a screen empty to use the default wallpaper.
appearance.applyHint: Preview changes before saving. Saving reloads this window and applies the theme on new visits. Already-open games keep their current appearance.
appearance.resetConfirm: Restore the original name, colors, logo and wallpapers? Uploaded assets are retained for already-open games.

spreadsheet.help: JSON keeps the native quiz. XLSX exchanges standard questions with Kahoot.
spreadsheet.limits: No data is saved or downloaded until you confirm. Unsupported questions block export. Keep JSON for a full quiz backup (media files are separate).
spreadsheet.invalid: Invalid spreadsheet. Use the Kahoot question template (.xlsx, maximum 1 MiB), not a game report.

issues.question: Question must have 1–120 characters.
issues.answers: Provide 2–4 non-empty answers, maximum 75 characters each.
issues.solutions: Correct answers must be unique numbers pointing to existing answers.
issues.metadata: Media, explanations and categories will not be included.
issues.scoring: Reading delay, scoring rules or multi-answer behavior may differ in Kahoot.
issues.cell: Formulas and rich, linked or embedded cells are unsupported; use plain values.
issues.defaults: The filename becomes the quiz title. Reading delay: 5 seconds; default scoring; multiple correct answers use strict selection. The spreadsheet contains no media or original game rules.
